environment.description: ECS Fargate task running the document conversion service. Container image based on ubuntu:22.04 with LibreOffice 7.3 installed. Task role has s3:GetObject/PutObject on the documents bucket. Container runs as root (default). Service is behind an ALB with no additional request filtering. The task definition uses awsvpc networking mode with a security group allowing inbound TCP/8080 from the ALB and all outbound traffic. No resource constraints beyond Fargate defaults (2 vCPU, 4GB RAM).
